Troleandomycin (BAN, USAN, rINN) NSC-108166; Triacetyloleandomycin; Troleandomicina; Trolean- domisin; Troléandomycine; Troleandomycinum; Troleandomysii- ni. The triacetyl ester of oleandomycin. Тролеандомицин C41H67NO15 = 814.0. CAS — 2751-09-9. ATC — J01FA08. ATC Vet — QJ01FA08. Pharmacopoeias. In Fr. and US. USP 31 (Troleandomycin). A white, odourless, crystalline pow- der. It contains the equivalent of not less than 750 micrograms of oleandomycin per mg. Slightly soluble in water and in ether; freely soluble in alcohol; soluble in chloroform. A 10% solution in alcohol and water (1:1) has a pH of 7.0 to 8.5. Store in airtight containers. Profile Troleandomycin is a prodrug of the macrolide antibacterial ole- andomycin that has actions similar to those of erythromycin (p.269). It has been given orally in the treatment of susceptible infections although more effective antibacterials are generally preferred. Preparations USP 31: Troleandomycin Capsules.
